_note: The baseline Shaft — the player's home in Chapters 1 and 2. Other profiles express their character as a delta over this one, which is what the glossary calls a Shaft profile.
name: The Shaft

layout._note: Vertical arrangement. deepestHabitedLevel gates where population may live; digFaceLevel is where extraction currently sits.

opening._note: The Shaft as the player inherits it: [buildingId, level] pairs, placed and fully staffed through the same commands the player uses, so the opening lands in the command log and replays with everything else. Level 1 was built before anyone alive: the auditorium and the Exit carry a fixed block in the catalogue and go only where it says. Cultivation sits high and the canteens low, so food is hauled a long way down — which is what puts porters on the stairwell where they can be watched.

startingStocks._note: What the settlement has in hand at tick zero. Structure rather than a tunable, like layout and veins, because it is a map of resource ids and not a scalar the schema can range-check. Read by core/gameState.js — and being in data rather than boot code is what lets a run replay from its command log alone.
